name: Pixel sunset sky
doc: Integrates the input media into a Bayer-dithered pixel-art vaporwave sunset sky with a slatted bass-reactive sun, spectrum mountains sculpted by media luma, swaying pixel palms, and shimmering water-grid reflections.

in.doc: media painted into the sunset sky and reflected in the water

luma.doc: media brightness (drives sky cloud glow and mountain height)

edges.doc: media contours (neon pixel rim highlights on onsets)

sky_mix.doc: How strongly the input media shapes and colors the sunset sky

sun_size.doc: Radius of the slatted retro sun

speed.doc: Scroll speed of neon water grid and sky drift

glow.doc: Neon intensity of sun, grid, and onset edge flares
